name: Hitesh Goyal
title: Applied AI Engineer | Vision · NLP · Systems
summary: Building production-grade AI systems across computer vision, language, and generative models — wherever the problem is hardest.

about.bio: I start with the data: what it represents, how it should be prepared, and what the problem actually needs. From there, I choose the method that fits and carry it through to a working system.
highlights: I have applied that approach across speech, computer vision, biotech, and multimodal retrieval, using anything from classical methods and deep learning to generative models when the problem calls for it.
I work across the full path from data preparation and experimentation to evaluation, deployment, databases, and usable interfaces.
I optimise for real constraints such as latency, compute, data quality, and measurable performance.
